_about: Start of the simulated game (web/js/game_sim.js), not mod data. gold: as at the start of Malakai's campaign on the user's screenshot (docs/design/panel-upgrades-proposal.md, section 4); income per turn is not modelled; built: the hull already stands, so the barge exists. dev_points: the horde's development points («избыток населения») at the start, 0 as the game had them in run 20261114-230723. They come from the horde's growth as the game counts it (docs/design/port-to-game.md 8.5): growth accumulated at the start; growth_base: the horde's own growth per turn besides «Рост орды: +N» of the standing buildings (guess 0: run 20261115-012811 had hull II's +10 and 0 points after the turn); growth_threshold: growth per point (the game's campaign_variables military_force_development_point_growth_threshold); dev_max: the most points a horde holds (military_force_development_max_development_points). ask_cancel: the game's window before a cancel of an earlier turn's construction; off, the page has no game window.
